blocks.text: A believable auditory reality also had to be a historically accurate one, which sometimes meant giving up a good idea.

"In the scene of Tilly's hospitalization, following her accident with a military vehicle, we were tempted to feature the beeping of a heart monitor, which is such an iconic sound of a hospital environment, but of course we had to give it up, as such monitors didn't exist at the time." — Amit

"We became fascinated by the idea of placing the juvenile judge as the implicit listener in his office, listening to witness statements from archival police reports on a tape recorder. [...] But making this choice would have required an anachronism. It would have suggested that the judge was listening to a tape recorder at a historical moment when such a scene simply could not have taken place." — Tzlil
